name: Claim RRSP Deduction and Report Tips
description: Open StudioTax 2024 and create a new tax return for Terry Lee. Read the scenario file at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\TaxScenarios\scenario_terry_lee.txt for all required data. Enter the following: (1) Personal information — name: Terry Lee, SIN: 284-567-898, DOB: July 22, 1998, marital status: Single, province: British Columbia, address: 456 Oak Avenue, Vancouver, BC V5K 1A1. (2) Add a T4 slip from Plaza Di Pizza with Box 14: $12,000.00 employment income, Box 16: $480.00 CPP, Box 18: $200.00 EI, Box 22: $200.00 tax deducted. (3) Report cash tips of $1,000.00 as Other Employment Income on Line 10400. (4) Navigate to the RRSP section (Schedule 7) and enter an RRSP contribution of $540.00 with an RRSP deduction limit of $2,160.00. (5) Save the return as 'terry_lee.24t' in C:\Users\Docker\Documents\StudioTax.
